store.title: Digital Products
store.subtitle: Templates, source code, UI kits, ebooks and automation resources built by NEURAL AURORA — instant download, first-party, no marketplace in between.
store.noProductsBody: New digital products will appear here as soon as they are published.
store.noResultsBody: Try a different search term or clear the active filters.
store.errorBody: Something went wrong while fetching products. Please try again.
store.productNotFoundBody: This product does not exist or is no longer available.
store.phoneNote: Used only to send your download link on WhatsApp if the sign-in email cannot reach you.
store.phoneRequired: Enter a phone number (add the country code if you are outside India) so we can send your download link.
store.checkoutFailed: Checkout could not be started. Please try again.
store.emailRequired: Enter an email address so your purchase can be recovered.
store.secureNote: Payment is processed securely by Razorpay. Your download is unlocked only after the payment is verified on the server.
store.freeNote: Sign in with your email and password (or request a one-time sign-in link) to unlock this download and keep it in your library.
store.magicLinkSentBody: Copy this link and open it in your browser to sign in to your library. No email was sent.
store.librarySubtitle: Every digital product you have purchased or downloaded, ready to re-download at any time.
store.libraryEmptyBody: Products you buy or download will appear here.
store.libraryError: We could not load your library. Please try again.
store.signInBody: Enter the email you used at checkout and we'll show you a secure sign-in link — no email is sent.
store.signInPasswordBody: Sign in with your email and your password. Nothing is emailed, so nothing can be delayed or limited.
store.passwordSignInNote: Set your password once from inside your library and from then on you can sign in any time — no waiting for a link or email.
store.invalidCredentials: That email and password did not match. If you have never set a password, use "Email me a link" once, then set one inside your library.
store.emailNotConfirmed: This email is not confirmed yet. Use "Email me a link" once, then set a password inside your library.
store.setPasswordNudge: Sign in without any email: set a password once and your library is always one step away. Your session is remembered on this device too.
store.setPasswordBody: Set a password once and you can open your library any time — no link or email needed.
store.passwordSetStatus: A password is set on this account. Sign in any time with your email and password — nothing is emailed.
store.passwordMismatch: The two passwords do not match.
store.passwordFailed: We could not save that password. Please try again.
store.passwordReauthRequired: This store requires a fresh email before a password change. Use "Email me a link" once, then set your password here.
store.signInNote: We only use this to prove the purchase is yours. We never issue a permanent download link to an unverified address.
store.signInSupport: No link after a few minutes? Try again or contact us for help.
store.signInFailed: We could not generate the sign-in link. Please try again in a moment.
store.signInRateLimited: Sign-in emails are temporarily unavailable — the mail service limits how many can be sent per hour. Please try again a little later, or contact us and we'll send you a direct sign-in link.
store.magicLinkSentSupport: The link expires in about an hour. If it expires, request a new one.
store.downloadFailed: We could not prepare your download. Please try again.
store.purchaseError: We could not check your order status. Please try again.

loading.title: Checking your payment
loading.body: One moment while we confirm this order with the payment provider.

pending.title: Confirming your payment
pending.body: Your payment was submitted. We are waiting for the provider to confirm it — this usually takes a few seconds.

slow.title: Still confirming
slow.body: This is taking longer than usual. Your order is safe: access is granted automatically as soon as the payment is confirmed. You can check again from your library.

paid.title: Payment confirmed
paid.body: Thank you. Your purchase is unlocked — open your library to download it.

failed.title: Payment failed
failed.body: The payment did not go through, so no access was granted and you have not been charged for the product. You can try again.

cancelled.title: Payment cancelled
cancelled.body: The checkout was cancelled before payment completed. No access was granted.

refunded.title: Payment refunded
refunded.body: This order has been refunded. Access to the product has been withdrawn.

error.title: We could not confirm this order
error.body: Something went wrong while checking the order. If you were charged, your access will still be granted automatically — check your library shortly.

purchase.guestHint: Sign in with the email you used at checkout to see this purchase in your library.
